reviews.name: Asaf Amir
reviews.text: Excellent service and very professional work. The team was reliable, knowledgeable, and did a great job. Highly recommend them for any boat repair and maintenance needs!

reviews.name: davidbaldav
reviews.text: Excellent service from Doctor Yachts! Very professional, responsive, and knowledgeable. They took great care of the boat and made the whole process easy from start to finish. Quality work and great communication. Highly recommend!

reviews.text:
Best outboard motor repair in Fort Lauderdale.

I found my new company for maintenance.

reviews.name: Anıl Türkyılmaz
reviews.text:
They came out yesterday to work on my Silverton 410, and I couldn’t be happier with their service!

This is definitely a team I’ll continue working with. They are very professional, knowledgeable, and deliver great results. They quickly identified the issue and did everything they could to provide the best possible solution.

I’m extremely satisfied with their work and look forward to working with them on a regular basis. Highly recommended!

Thank you!!!

reviews.name: Clevis Cruz
reviews.text:
Great service and very professional work! They replaced both batteries on my Mercury V8 300 HP and made sure everything was properly connected and working correctly. The job was done efficiently, with great attention to detail.

Very knowledgeable about marine systems and Mercury engines. I highly recommend this company for boat repairs and maintenance!
